spans.s: दिक्करिन् m. elephant of a region (myth.).

दिक्चक्र n. circuit of the quarters of the compass,
horizon.

दिक्चक्रवाल n. circuit of the quarters of the
compass, horizon.
दिक्छब्द m. a word denoting a direction (g.).

दिक्पति m. the regent or guardian of a quarter of the
world (myth.).

दीक्ष् दी॑क्षते pp. दीक्षित॑ (q.v.) be consecrated. C.
दीक्ष॑यति, ˚ते consecrate. D. दिदीक्षिषते wish to be consecrated.
— अभि = S.

दीक्षणी॑य a. relating to consecration, f. आ the
ceremony of consecration.

दीक्षापा॑ल m. guardian of consecration (Agni or
Viṣṇu).

दीक्षित॑ f. ˚ती consecrated for (dat., loc., instr., or
—˚), prepared, ready for (dat., instr., loc., or —˚);
 abstr. ˚त्व†
n. — Often ˚— or —˚ in names, esp. of Brahmans.
